phase: Phase 4 — Real-Time Threat Detection, Security Dashboard & Manual Response System

components.api_service: FastAPI v1 with modular routers, tenant scoping, and OpenAPI specs
components.database: SQLite development engine with foreign keys, WAL mode, and migrations
components.frontend: React 18 / TypeScript / Vite / Tailwind CSS Security Operations Dashboard
components.window_engine: 30s event-time windowing with 60s lateness tolerance and checkpoints
components.inference_engine: LightGBM Deployable Subset (14 features, sub-millisecond CPU inference)
components.detection_rules: Deterministic rules FCS-R101 through FCS-R104 with risk scoring
components.incident_manager: Durable deduplication, lifecycle transitions, and transactional outbox
components.response_policy: Strict Manual Mode with RBAC, protected targets, TTL, and rollback
components.firewall_simulator: Isolated in-memory/DB software simulator with verifiable rule tables

G01_tenant_boundaries.name: Multi-Tenant Boundary & Data Isolation
G01_tenant_boundaries.evidence: RBAC verification, negative cross-tenant IDOR tests for incidents and action execution passed (403 Forbidden).

G02_ingestion.name: Supported Flow Telemetry Ingestion
G02_ingestion.evidence: FlowEvent v1 normalization, timestamp validation, sequence tracking, and duplicate rejection tested.

G03_durable_delivery.name: Durable Delivery & Idempotent Processing
G03_durable_delivery.evidence: Feature window checkpointing, persistent incident store, transactional notification outbox, and unique idempotency keys tested.

G06_model_safety.name: Candidate Model Integrity & Feature Parity
G06_model_safety.evidence: Candidate model manifest digest verified, deployable_v1 14-feature contract enforced, network_action_executed = False invariant verified.

G07_detection.name: Threat Detection & Risk Assessment
G07_detection.evidence: Volumetric flood, SYN scan, and normal traffic replay validated; 0 false positive alerts on normal replay; deduplication active.

G08_manual_response.name: Manual Response Policy & Simulated Execution
G08_manual_response.evidence: Mandatory administrator review (SECURITY_RESPONDER / TENANT_ADMIN), protected target allowlist, TTL expiry, rollback, and audit journal verified.

G13_auto_response.name: Autonomous Response Execution
G13_auto_response.evidence: Autonomous execution is strictly disabled. Backend hardcodes MANUAL mode; AUTO requests are rejected with 403.
